annotation.summary_en: Vietnam's Law on People's Air Defense (49/2024/QH15), effective 1 July 2025, organises civil-military air defense and establishes a comprehensive regime for unmanned aircraft and other flying vehicles: import/export licensing, manufacturing eligibility certificates, technical standards, registration, flight permits, pilot licenses, flight suspension, and powers to suppress and seize drones, under Ministry of National Defense control.
key_provisions_or_claims: Unmanned aircraft must be registered before operation and meet MND-issued technical standards
Flight permits required, with exemption for sub-0.25 kg recreational drones flown within visual range outside restricted areas
Drone operators must be 18+, have full civil capacity and hold a flight control license
Research, manufacture, repair and trade in drones require certificates of eligibility; import/export licensed by MND/MPS/MOIT
Military and police may suspend, suppress (jam/disable) and seize drones violating permits or carrying weapons/illegal goods
